description.html: Sphagnum moss (peat) in a 5-liter pack is a specialized substrate with an exceptional ability to hold moisture - it can absorb up to 20 times its weight in water. This makes it ideal for humid terrariums, humid hides that help with shedding, and incubating reptile eggs. For leopard geckos, a humid hide with sphagnum moss is essential - it helps them shed safely and prevents problems with stuck skin. In tropical terrariums it can be used as a top layer over coconut coir for extra moisture retention. It is naturally antibacterial and resistant to mold. It can also be used to create naturalistic decorations in combination with bark and twigs.
